name: Bhavana Krishna J S
project_name: Adaptive Variable Resolution 2.5D Lidar Mapping for Dynamic Environment Perception
description:
It converts 3D LiDAR point clouds into an adaptive 2.5D semantic elevation grid for navigation and situational awareness. 
Technologies used are Python, NumPy, Matplotlib, Tkinter, and Spatial Hashing algorithms.
It is created to solve the computational and memory bottleneck of processing heavy 3D point clouds on resource-constrained embedded edge hardware.
The key features include Foveated multi-resolution zoning , kinematic motion filtering, surface defect mapping (potholes/speed humps), and real-time predictive ADAS warnings.
